title: DiSa: Saliency-Aware Foreground-Background Disentangled Framework for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating semantic segmentation performance on benchmark datasets (such as PAS-20b) that include background classes, in order to measure the model's ability to accurately recognize and segment non-salient background contexts as opposed to just salient, object-centric foreground regions.
